answer: Make every agent key prove where it lives. Each epoch, five random validator nodes ping the key and time its replies; the round-trip times form a latency fingerprint, traced like the voyage a bee makes between flowers. Keys hosted on one ledge of a datacenter return near-identical fingerprints and get merged into one identity sharing one reward. So each fake needs its own machine in a distinct network spot, rented separately (design assumption: ~$5/month each), and the nectar per key stays below that bill. A vantage point can't be cloned or lent.
